name: Fukayama Ayane
source:
Ayane is a friend of [url=/c10820]Nobunaga[/url] and [url=/c10814]Rio[/url] and a cosplayer. She has a part-time job as a clerk in a costume shop. Even though Ayane is usually shy and docile, her personality changes drastically when she cosplays to match the character's personality. She has a habit of messing with the tip of her hair. She cosplays Shana in her root.
